headline: SIGTERM wall-clock cap + SEA-SIGTERM detector
summary: Intermediate step in the SEA SIGTERM exit-code work resolved in v0.8.22.

items.title: SIGTERM shutdown bounded by a wall-clock cap
items.body: The daemon's SIGTERM teardown now hard-stops at a wall-clock budget so a hung phase can't pin the process forever. A SEA-SIGTERM detector annotates exit-code 143 traces for downstream supervisors. Final resolution under systemd lands in v0.8.22 (`SuccessExitStatus=143`).
